vulnerable_code:
class Ability
  include CanCan::Ability

  def initialize(user)
    return unless user.present?

    # When user has an empty array of facility_ids, CanCanCan SQL generator
    # fails to bind an impossible condition on some adapter versions
    can :control, SmartDevice, location: { facility_id: user.assigned_facility_ids }
  end
end

class Iot::DevicesController < ApplicationController
  def reboot
    @device = SmartDevice.find(params[:id])
    authorize! :control, @device

    @device.trigger_reboot!
    render json: { status: 'rebooting' }
  end
end
diagnosis: The ability rule passes user.assigned_facility_ids without checking whether the array is populated. When an offboarded technician with empty facility assignments triggers device actions, evaluation anomalies permit sending reboot signals to critical industrial sensors.

corrected_code:
class Ability
  include CanCan::Ability

  def initialize(user)
    return unless user.present?

    if user.assigned_facility_ids.present?
      can :control, SmartDevice, location: { facility_id: user.assigned_facility_ids }
    end
  end
end

class Iot::DevicesController < ApplicationController
  def reboot
    @device = SmartDevice.find(params[:id])
    authorize! :control, @device

    @device.trigger_reboot!
    render json: { status: 'rebooting' }
  end
end
